summary: Square's original PlayStation science-fiction RPG, the debut entry in the broader Xeno lineage before Xenosaga and Xenoblade became separate spiritual-successor branches.

entries.title: Xenogears

emulation.notes: Use internal resolution scaling, PGXP/geometry correction, and widescreen only if it does not break UI or scenes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation assets with high-quality PS1 emulation and modern capture.

primary.why: Xenogears has not received a sourced modern remaster; the original PlayStation release remains the complete version, with high-quality PS1 emulation offering the best fidelity/capture route for an owned copy.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation disc or disc image through DuckStation with PGXP/geometry correction and internal resolution scaling. The older PlayStation Network PSOne Classic is a legal digital route where still accessible.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or remake; do not conflate it with Xenosaga or Xenoblade, which are separate successor branches.
